meta_description:
15K likes, 223 comments - htcityshowstoppers on October 18, 2026: "With a quiet grace and a presence that speaks volumes, Dia Mirza (@diamirzaofficial) makes a statement without saying a word.

Dia is wearing a pink Banarasi Katan silk saree by Vidhi Singhania (@vidhi_singhania) featuring leaf buti work and traditional konia corner motifs, paired with a statement necklace from Manubhai Jewellers (@manubhaijewels). 

Creative Direction: Shara Ashraf Prayag Mishra (@sharaashraf)
Styling: Theia Tekchandaney (@theiatekchandaney)
Makeup: Harry Rajput (@harryrajput64)
Hair: Vithika Jaiswal (@vithikajaiswal)
Production: Zahera Kayanat (@kayanaaaaat) and
Prachi Sapra (@_prachisapra_)
On-set Support Team: Ayushi Mishra (@styledbyayushi), Sameera Shaikh (@sam_wearable_art) 
Home Decor & Soft Furnishings: House of the Designery (@house_of_the_designery)
Plant Partner: Plant People (@plantpeople.in)
Location: Prestige Nautilus, Mumbai (@prestigeconstructions)
Artist Reputation Management: Communiqué Film PR (@communiquefilmpr) 

#dia #diamirza #diamirzafans #cover #covershoot".
